potentialRisks.risk: Analytics endpoint performance with large datasets
potentialRisks.description: Analytics router aggregates activity_executions table without pagination or limits. With thousands of executions, queries may become slow.
potentialRisks.mitigation: Add pagination support to /analytics/templates endpoint. Consider database indexes on template_id, started_at columns.
potentialRisks.monitoring: Track query response times in RPC API metrics

potentialRisks.risk: SurrealDB schema changes breaking analytics queries
potentialRisks.description: Analytics router uses SurrealDB queries that assume specific table schema. Schema changes could break aggregation.
potentialRisks.mitigation: Document activity_executions schema as a contract. Use database migrations for schema changes. Add integration tests.

potentialRisks.risk: Redis cache invalidation for analytics data
potentialRisks.description: Analytics endpoints query SurrealDB directly without Redis caching. This is intentional (always fresh data), but may increase DB load.
potentialRisks.mitigation: Current approach is acceptable - analytics queries are infrequent (dashboard polling every 60s). If load increases, add Redis caching with TTL.
potentialRisks.monitoring: Monitor SurrealDB query load from analytics endpoints
